newsitem.title: CHINA: China National Petrochemical sees $843 mln 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: China National Petrochemical sees $843 mln 1996 profit.

text.p: China National Petrochemical Corp is forecasting profits of 7.0 billion yuan ($843.4 million) in 1996, the offical Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
It did not say what the percentage change in profits would be.
Taxes paid by the state-owned corporation would come to 24.5 billion yuan, a rise of 7.5 percent from last year, the agency said.
Many of China National Petrochemical's subsidiaries were expected to report higher profits in 1996, Xinhua said without elaborating.
The corporation had managed to cut production costs despite rising international prices for crude oil and falling prices for chemical and chemical fibre products, it said.
The volume of crude oil processed by the corporation was seen growing by 4.2 percent this year while output of petrol, kerosene, diesel fuel and lubricants was seen up 9.5 percent, it said.
Production of urea was expected to hit 5.75 million tonnes, above the year's target of 5.4 million tonnes, it said.
